goofy: make goofy use test_list_iterator Goofy is now using new test_list_iterator to maintain test list running state. The following features / APIs are no longer required / provided anymore. * UpdateSkippedTests: the run_if function is now evaluated when a test gets a chance to run, so we don't need to call this function to update skipping status of tests when device data is changed. * starting_at: the "starting_at" argument was provided by auto_run and other similar functions. This argument made Goofy start running from a given test and continue all the following tests, which is different from providing a "root", and only run tests under this node. Currently, we don't see any requirement for this feature. To simplify the implementation of TestListIterator, this feature is now removed. Can add it back when we find this feature is useful. * backgroundable and force_background: These test attributes were made to allow tests running in parallel. However, these would increase unnecessary complexity to test list execution logic. We provide a new attribute "parallel" to FactoryTest, which means that all subtests of this test should be run in parallel. UPSTREAM: net: add recursion limit to GRO [ Upstream commit fcd91dd449867c6bfe56a81cabba76b829fd05cd ] Currently, GRO can do unlimited recursion through the gro_receive handlers. This was fixed for tunneling protocols by limiting tunnel GRO to one level with encap_mark, but both VLAN and TEB still have this problem. Thus, the kernel is vulnerable to a stack overflow, if we receive a packet composed entirely of VLAN headers. This patch adds a recursion counter to the GRO layer to prevent stack overflow. When a gro_receive function hits the recursion limit, GRO is aborted for this skb and it is processed normally. This recursion counter is put in the GRO CB, but could be turned into a percpu counter if we run out of space in the CB. Thanks to Vladimr Bene <vbenes@redhat.com> for the initial bug report.
